title: 第156章 这真是人画出来的玩意？
slug: 综艺大导演从齐聚初代跑男开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

房间内，Baby坐在一张小桌子前。

面前摊着一张A4纸和一支黑色记号笔。

她对着镜头露出一个自信的笑容：“画画这种事我可是专业的，等着看我表演吧。”

然后她拿起桌上的卡片，看到了上面的内容。

笑容僵住。

“……”

Baby盯着卡片看了三秒钟，然后默默把卡片翻过去，深呼吸了一口，“导演，我能申请换一个吗？”

门外的邓朝听到她的话，顿时心里一紧：“怎么了？很难吗？”

Baby的声音从门内传来，带着一丝抓狂：“这玩意儿怎么画啊！”

另一边迪丽热八同样拿起卡片。

她看了一眼，然后非常干脆地拿起笔开始画画。

动作飞快，表情非常认真。

门外孙洪雷双手叉腰，信心满满：“我相信热八，以她的画画水平，应该没问题！”

黄博看了他一眼：“你见过她画画？”

“没有啊，我猜的。”

黄垒沉默了一秒，然后拍了拍他的肩膀：“行吧，你开心就好。”

五分钟后。

门缝下面同时塞出两张画纸。

203室门口的邓朝弯腰捡起来，展开一看。

纸上画着一个……东西。

只能称之为“东西”。

看起来像是一个圆形的物体。

上面有弯曲的线条，旁边还画了几个小圆圈。

最底下有一条歪歪扭扭的横线。

什么玩意这是？

整幅画的旁边，Baby还非常认真地写了一个箭头标注：“这个很重要！！！”

邓朝无论怎么看，都满脸疑惑：“这到底是什么？”

陈鹤凑过来说道：“从构图来看，圆形的应该是主体，上面的弯曲线条，可能是头发？或者是某种装饰？”

郑凯也凑过来，左看右看：“这是头盔？不对，头盔哪有这种波浪啊。”

Baby的声音从门内传来：“我画的这么好！猜不出来那就是你们自己的问题了！”

三人同时沉默。

这幅画跟“好”字有任何关系吗？

“等一下。”

陈鹤忽然指着画上的一个细节，“这个圆形下面，有一道弧线，像是一个笑脸的嘴巴？”

邓朝仔细一看：“还真是。”

郑凯也眯起眼：“所以这是个人脸吗？”

Page (1/3)

In the room, Baby was sitting at a small table.

Spread in front of you is an A4 paper and a black marker.

She showed a confident smile to the camera: "I'm professional at painting. Just wait and see my performance."

Then she picked up the card on the table and saw what was on it.

The smile froze.

"..."

Baby stared at the card for three seconds, then silently turned it over and took a deep breath, "Director, can I apply for a replacement?"

When Deng Chao outside the door heard her words, his heart suddenly tightened: "What's wrong? Is it difficult?"

Baby's voice came from inside the door, with a hint of madness: "How do you draw this thing!"

On the other side, Dilireba also picked up the card.

She took a look, then picked up the pen very simply and started drawing.

His movements were fast and his expression was very serious.

Outside the door, Sun Honglei put his hands on his hips and said with full confidence: "I believe Reba, with her painting skills, she should be fine!"

Huang Bo glanced at him: "Have you seen her painting?"

"No, I guessed it."

Huang Lei was silent for a second, then patted him on the shoulder: "Okay, as long as you are happy."

Five minutes later.

Two pieces of drawing paper were stuffed under the door at the same time.

Deng Chao at the door of Room 203 bent down to pick it up and unfolded it for a look.

There is something drawn on the paper.

It can only be called "something".

It looks like a round object.

There are curved lines on it and a few small circles drawn next to it.

There is a crooked horizontal line at the bottom.

What the hell is this?

Next to the whole painting, Baby also wrote an arrow mark very carefully: "This is very important!!!"

No matter how he looked at it, Deng Chao was full of doubts: "What on earth is this?"

Chen He came over and said, "Judging from the composition, the round shape should be the main body, and the curved lines on it could be hair? Or some kind of decoration?"

Zheng Kai also came over and looked left and right: "Is this a helmet? No, there are no such waves in the helmet."

Baby's voice came from inside the door: "I draw so well! If you can't guess, it's your own problem!"

The three of them were silent at the same time.

Does this painting have anything to do with the word "good"?

"Wait a minute."

Chen He suddenly pointed to a detail in the painting, "Under this circle, is there an arc, like the mouth of a smiling face?"

Deng Chao took a closer look: "It's true."

Zheng Kai also narrowed his eyes: "So is this a human face?"
